title: Local-Only Fields
description: Define local-only fields with the @client directive to store client-side data in the Apollo cache.

data.text: The `@client` directive tells Apollo Client to resolve a field from the local cache instead of sending it to the server. Local-only fields are useful for storing UI state, computed values, or data that only exists on the client.

data.title: Local-only field query
data.content: Querying local-only fields alongside remote fields.

data.text: You can write to local-only fields using cache.modify or by including them in mutation results. This lets you keep UI state in sync with server state while maintaining a single source of truth in the cache.
Local-only fields are stored in the same normalized cache as server data. This means they participate in the same reactivity system and can be observed with the same hooks.
data.title: Unified Cache
Local-Only Fields Key Points
points: Local fields live in the same cache as server data.
Use cache.modify to update local fields.
Combine remote and local data in one query.
data.takeaway: Local-only fields blur the line between server and client state in a clean, Apollo-native way.
